items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) was upgraded to limited Thursday; WR Adonai Mitchell and G Dylan Parham limited both days; LB Kiko Mauigoa and EDGE Joseph Ossai did not practice Wednesday.
Miami QB Malik Willis (thumb) practiced fully Wednesday; CB Reese Taylor (quad) did not practice. RB De'Von Achane is out for the season (ACL).
